explication: 中国专利.skill is a collection of agent-invoked patent workflows, not one monolithic application. Its documented capabilities span invention-disclosure drafting, application preparation, docket coordination, patent reading and mapping, office-action assistance, claim charts, bibliographic search, and policy briefs. The README supports these as separate user-facing branches; sampled source and the SOURCE INDEX support selected internal links. Most skill implementations were not sampled, so their internal workflows are represented at subsystem level rather than inferred.
